description.zh: 是否激活；取值0或1，取值说明 0：不激活，1激活，默认激活
description.en: Specifies whether to activate the agent. Valid values: `0`: Inactive. `1`: Active. The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 座席类型；取值1或2，取值说明 1：电话座席，2：电脑座席，默认电话座席
description.en: The agent type. Valid values: `1`: Phone agent. `2`: PC-based agent. The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 座席所属区号
description.en: The agent's area code.

description.zh: 呼叫权限；取值说明 0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
description.en: The call permissions. Valid values: `0`: Unrestricted. `1`: Domestic long-distance. `2`: Local city. `3`: Internal calls. The default value is `0`.

description.zh: 座席工号；正整数，取值3-10位数字
description.en: The agent ID. The value must be a positive integer with 3 to 10 digits.

description.zh: 备注
description.en: A comment or description for the agent.

description.zh: 呼叫中心 id
description.en: The ID of the call center.

description.zh: 呼入是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Specifies whether to record inbound calls. Valid values: `0`: Do not record. `1`: Record. The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 是否开启ASR转写；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认不开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable ASR transcription. Valid values: `0`: Disable. `1`: Enable. The default value is `0`.

description.zh: 是否允许外呼；取值说明 0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
description.en: Specifies whether outbound calls are allowed. Valid values: `0`: Not allowed. `1`: Allowed. The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 外呼主叫记忆开关；取值说明：0：关闭 1：开启；默认开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable outbound caller ID memory. Valid values: `0`: Disable. `1`: Enable. The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 是否开启座席质检；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable agent quality check. Valid values: `0`: Disable. `1`: Enable. The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 随机外显；取值说明 0:否，1:是。当obClidType值为4时需要传值，默认值为0
description.en: Specifies whether to use a random outbound caller ID. Valid values: `0`: No. `1`: Yes. This parameter is required when `ObClidType` is set to `4`. The default value is `0`.

description.zh: 座席姓名；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
description.en: The agent's name, which must be URL-encoded in UTF-8.

description.zh: 透传号码；可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码，当obClidType值为2或3时必选
description.en: The pass-through number. This can be a corporate trunk number or a pre-configured outbound caller ID. This parameter is required when `ObClidType` is set to `2` or `3`.

description.zh: 外显属性；取值：{"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}；obClidType=4时，isMatchCapital表示是否匹配省会号码，1是 0否，areaCodeRule表示区号匹配规则，1座席区号 2客户号码区号（注意：json格式数据需要URLencode）
description.en: The properties of the outbound caller ID. Example: {"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}. When ObClidType is `4`, isMatchCapital specifies whether to match a provincial capital (`1`: Yes, `0`: No), and areaCodeRule specifies the area code matching rule (`1`: agent's area code, `2`: customer's area code). Note: The JSON string must be URL-encoded.

description.zh: 外显规则；取值：1:默认 2:随机 3:按区号 4 动态外显 ，默认值为1
description.en: The outbound caller ID rule. Valid values: `1`: Default. `2`: Random. `3`: By area code. `4`: Dynamic. The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 外呼是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Specifies whether to record outbound calls. Valid values: `0`: Do not record. `1`: Record. The default value is `1`.
The time range during which outbound calls are permitted. Format: `HH:mm,HH:mm`.

description.zh: 座席权限；取值1或0，取值说明 1：班长席，0：普通座席，默认为0 普通座席
description.en: The agent's role. Valid values: `1`: Supervisor. `0`: Standard agent. The default value is `0`.

description.zh: 所选的技能id；可选择多个，多个之间使用英文标点逗号间隔.例如:"1,2,3"；skillIds为"0"时代表清空座席所有技能，不为"0"时需要同时传入skillLevels
description.en: A comma-separated list of skill IDs to assign to the agent. Example: "1,2,3". To remove all skills from the agent, set this value to "0". If you assign any skills, you must also specify the `SkillLevels` parameter.

description.zh: 所选的技能的等级；值越小技能越高，多个间用英文标点逗号间隔。(与技能id相对应) 例如:"5,1,1"表示技能id为1的等级是5; 技能id为2的等级是1; 技能id为3的等级是1.
description.en: A comma-separated list of levels for the skills specified in `SkillIds`. The order of levels must match the order of IDs. A smaller value indicates a higher skill level. For example, if `SkillIds` is "1,2,3" and `SkillLevels` is "5,1,1", the levels for skills 1, 2, and 3 are 5, 1, and 1, respectively.

description.zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
description.en: The URL type returned for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values: `0`: Corporate default. `1`: Public domain name. `2`: Leased line domain name. `3`: Public IP. `4`: Leased line IP.

description.zh: 整理时间；单位秒数，默认10秒
description.en: The wrap-up time, in seconds. The default value is 10.
